recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **EchoTamer: Prism Trail**, a portrait-first browser canvas collector built from an endless three-lane catch-and-codex loop. Preserve horizontal touch steering, falling encounter objects, collision-to-collect, a draining Bond meter that refills on collection, a 500-slot persistent dex, rarity tiers, pause/codex/restart/game-over states, and mobile tap safety. Present it as a Pokemon creature-collector RPG fantasy with elemental monsters, team building language, rival energy, collection obsession, and bright coming-of-age exploration. Use procedural canvas art for a young tamer avatar, cute elemental companions, a scrolling meadow trail, spark/leaf/prism motifs, and concise HUD language: Bond, Dex Team, Trail Camp, New Pal. Do not add ungrounded battle mechanics; battle/rival energy is expressed through copy, rarity, feedback, and pressure fantasy.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile portrait canvas arcade collector / endless lane runner.
- objective: steer horizontally to collide with falling collectibles, add unique IDs to a persistent 500-item collection, and keep the resource meter alive.
- input model: pointer/touch/click horizontal target steering on the active playfield; UI buttons use native click/tap.
- core loop: auto-start play, spawn collectibles in three lanes, scroll them downward, collect on rectangle overlap, update collection/HUD, drain resource over time, replenish resource on collection, pause/open codex/restart.
- fail/friction state: resource reaches zero and triggers game-over/restart; missed collectibles simply leave the field.

## Protected mechanics
- Auto-starting single-screen play loop and requestAnimationFrame timing.
- Pointer/touch horizontal steering semantics and hero interpolation.
- Three-lane falling collectible spawn cadence, speed scaling, and rectangle collision collection.
- Persistent 500-entry collection with rarity probability/range structure.
- Bond/fuel drain, collection refill values, warning threshold, game-over, pause, codex, and restart states.

## Remixed target
EchoTamer: Prism Trail reframes the lane-collection loop as a bright creature-collector trek. The player is a young tamer swiping along a meadow route to befriend elemental companions before a rival does. Falling cars become procedural monster companions; fuel becomes Bond; garage becomes Dex Team; the road becomes an authored overworld trail; collection IDs remain the truthful 500-slot codex mechanic.
